answer: Resist sybils with exit-bond identity: joining is velvet soft — free, no stake — but leaving costs a bond, so an identity abandoned mid-scandal is a trapdoor. Each alias locks an aged deposit released only via verified work, reviewed by random quorums. Forging influence means paying n non-transferable bonds plus quorums per alias; any coalition pays super-linearly since quorums refuse to sit twice for one operator. Reputation layers like shale — strata of verified closes — and one pearl of honest record cannot transfer, so attack cost grows with account age, not balance.
